vqa_items.state: Does the ad show the retained base-copy identity: “FlowForge Sprint”, “Plan the week in one calm board.”, and “A focused planning space for small product teams.”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three retained base-copy strings are readable and materially exact.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly two strings are exact and the third is omitted or has one minor punctuation defect, with no different product or message.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if fewer than two strings are correct or a different product name, headline, or support message is used.

vqa_items.state: Does the ad show the publication-stage audience “For launch teams coordinating 8–24 contributors” and evidence line “Includes eight collaborator seats”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both lines are readable and exact, including the 8–24 range and eight-seat evidence.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both lines are identifiable and exactly one has a minor punctuation or numeral-format defect, with no old activation value.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either line is absent, materially different, or replaced by the 6–20/five-seat activation wording.

vqa_items.state: Does the ad show the final offer “30-day go-live workspace trial” and release line “Opens 24 June · 16:30 UTC”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both lines are readable and exact, including 30-day, 24 June, 16:30 and UTC.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both lines are present and exactly one has a minor separator or punctuation defect, with no wrong duration or time.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either line is missing or uses the earlier 21-day or 14:00 activation value, another date, or another timezone.

vqa_items.state: Does the ad use the final CTA “Start the go-live workspace”, destination “flowforge.com/go-live”, and qualifier “Workspace admin approval required”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three strings are readable, exact, and presented as the current action, destination, and qualifier.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly two are exact and the third is omitted or has one minor hyphen, slash, or capitalization defect, with no old value.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any displayed string is materially wrong or replaced by Open the launch-week board, flowforge.com/launch-week, or Workspace owner approval required, or if two strings are absent.

vqa_items.state: Does the proof area show “Ready for cross-functional go-live weeks”, and is exactly one complete horizontal FlowForge signature visible outside the product board?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the exact proof claim and one complete separate symbol-plus-wordmark signature are both clearly present.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both are identifiable and exactly one is slightly cropped, small, or has a minor punctuation defect, with no different proof claim.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the proof uses launch-weeks or focused-planning wording, the separate signature is absent or duplicated, or either required element is not identifiable.

vqa_items.state: Does the board show the pill “GO-LIVE WEEK”, highlight the WED lane, and feature the card “Publish release”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three board-state identifiers are directly visible and exact.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly two are correct and the third is omitted or partly obscured, with no conflicting board state.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if fewer than two are correct or LAUNCH WEEK, THU, Ship release, THIS WEEK, or Launch checklist is used as the current state.

vqa_items.state: Are the publication-selected key cards placed as MON—“Lock launch brief”, TUE—“Approve assets”, THU—“Monitor rollout”, and FRI—“Review launch data”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all four task-and-lane pairs are readable and correct.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly three pairs are correct and the fourth is omitted or slightly truncated, with no card assigned to the wrong lane.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or fewer pairs are correct, any shown key card is assigned to the wrong weekday, or earlier activation cards replace the publication cards.

vqa_items.state: Does the ad use the approved final asset combination: the safe go-live board without clipped task text, the warm cream grid background with sage upper-right band and amber lower-right corner, and the dark-teal left rail?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the safe board has no clipped task wording and all four specified background/rail features are present.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if the board is complete and exactly one background feature is substantially covered, or all background features are present and one non-core board task is slightly unclear.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if task text is visibly clipped, a dark or wrong background family is used, two background features are absent, or the board does not match the go-live state.

vqa_items.state: Does the delivered ad remain a single wide LinkedIn sponsored image with a 1200 × 627 or equivalent 1.91:1 canvas, one product board, one CTA, and one separate campaign signature?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the canvas is the required wide placement and the board, CTA, and separate signature each appear exactly once.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if the aspect ratio is a nearby compatible wide ratio and all three one-instance requirements are satisfied.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the image is square, portrait, banner-shaped, or materially cropped, or if the board, CTA, or separate signature is missing or duplicated.

vqa_items.state: Does the ad keep the final consumer copy internally consistent by using go-live wording across the offer, proof, CTA, destination, and board state rather than mixing launch-week and go-live packages?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the offer, proof, CTA, destination, and board state consistently use the final go-live package with no active launch-week substitute.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if four of the five components are consistent and exactly one component is omitted, with no conflicting launch-week wording.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any earlier launch-week component is shown as current alongside the go-live package, two components are missing, or the package is internally contradictory.

vqa_items.state: Is the ad free of the superseded activation values “21-day launch workspace trial”, “Opens 24 June · 14:00 UTC”, “Built for cross-functional launch weeks”, and “Open the launch-week board”?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if none of the four superseded values is visible as active copy.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly one appears as a tiny accidental remnant while its final replacement is also clearly present.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any superseded value replaces its final publication value or if two or more superseded values are visible.

vqa_items.state: Is the final image free of publication, activation, overlay, manifest, candidate-pack, asset, QA, legal, profile, approval, revision, worksheet, and other internal production identifiers?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if no readable internal identifier, status, source field, decision trace, or unrelated campaign fragment is visible.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly one tiny ambiguous non-core fragment remains but is not a readable identifier, status, or claim.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any internal production identifier or status is readable, a source/debug fragment appears, or multiple unrelated fragments remain.

vqa_items.state: As a paid social-media advertisement, does the image integrate brand, approved hero visual, headline, benefit or event message, proof or compliance content, and CTA into one platform-native, conversion-focused, highly polished composition rather than an internal draft or generic template?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the ad is exceptional and ready for paid placement without revision: brand, hero, message, benefit or proof, CTA, and required compliance text form one decisive focal hierarchy; the crop feels native to the declared platform; all essential text is readable at intended feed or story size; visual style is distinctive, premium, and coherent; and spacing, typography, imagery, contrast, and safe zones are meticulously controlled. No generic template feel, weak hero, competing copy, detached CTA, undersized disclaimer, malformed glyph, awkward crop, or visible rendering flaw is allowed. Any meaningful campaign-quality concern prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the ad is clear, usable, and looks acceptable or good, but it remains ordinary or visibly imperfect—for example, generic styling, modest brand or hero prominence, slightly small compliance text, competing messages, detached CTA, or a somewhat awkward crop.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 even when all expected elements are present if the ad looks visibly poor or would not be credible as paid media: focal hierarchy is weak, brand or offer is unclear, crop is badly handled, text is difficult to read, disclaimer or CTA is unusable, or the composition appears amateurish and needs substantial redesign. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, or broken outputs are also 0.
